name: elagoht/jobs
description: Package jobs runs scheduled jobs and typed background queues, only while the application serves, and finishes queued work on shutdown.
setup: Jobs are defined on the plugin, so keep it in a variable in `plugins.go` — `jobsPlugin := jobs.New(jobs.Options{})` — define them with `jobsPlugin.Every`, `jobsPlugin.Cron` or `jobs.NewQueue` before the application starts, and put `jobsPlugin` in the plugins list.

config.description: Package jobs runs scheduled jobs and typed background queues, only while the application serves, and finishes queued work on shutdown.

disabled.description: names of scheduled jobs that do not run; an unknown name fails startup

timezone.description: IANA time zone cron expressions are read in, default "UTC"
